description: This PHP class is part of the OrangeHRM system, implementing the MenuConfigurator interface to configure email subscription related menu options within the admin module. It overrides the screen with a specific view for email notifications.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implementing MenuConfigurator interface, this class configures the email subscription menu in the admin module by setting the current screen to 'viewEmailNotification'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewEmailNotification' for email subscription management and returns null.
